request.style: English, male baritone, powerful and steady, electric guitar, acoustic guitar, bass, drums, moody and reverent, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Roots go deep in the promised land
Where the shadows of ancestors stand
Caleb son of Hezron strong
His lineage is the song we sing
Azubah bore the sons of light
Jesher Shobab and Ardon tight
But when she died he found new grace
Ephrath bore the Hur who has a place

[Chorus]
Maacah bore the sons of the line
Sheber and Tirhanah aligned
Through the concubine the blood flows on
In the genealogy of Judah known

[Verse]
Ephah brought Haran Moza and Gazez
Harans father the one who came in last
Jahdai sons like Regem and Jotham
Geshan Pelet Ephah standing out
Maacah again with Sheber and Tirhanah
Shaaph the father of Madmannah
Sheva father of Macbenah too
And Gibea rises in the dew

[Chorus]
Maacah bore the sons of the line
Sheber and Tirhanah aligned
Through the concubine the blood flows on
In the genealogy of Judah known

[Bridge]
Caleb daughter Acsah stands apart
In the record of the fathers heart
Descendants of Caleb clear to see
The tribe of Judah set free

[Outro]
These are the descendants of Caleb
The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah
Shobal father of Kiriath Jearim
The line is marked for all to hear
